input.title: ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
input.bodyText:
ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
Zombie Match 3D (Puzzles vs Zombies) | Harmony Games | prepared by Julia Lawson, 1 Oct 2025

This brief covers the game as it plays today. Frederick has flagged that a core gameplay change is under consideration. If the core changes, we will redo the affected parts of this brief with you in November.

1. Start date
Kickoff and build start: Monday 3 November 2025 (the new date you are holding for us). We are aiming to have every file still owed (see the hand-off list) with you before then.

2. Scenario
We picked Scenario 1, the core game mechanic. What it is for: retention, not cheapest CPI. The aim is to filter out players who won't like the game, while staying true to the core gameplay, so test results reflect the real game. The player picks items freely and can make several matches if they're good enough; it is not on rails.

3. How a level plays (from the ZM3D design page and our reference level)
- Items sit in a physics pile on the board. The player drags items into a tray at the bottom.
- The tray has 7 slots. Any 3 matching items in the tray clear and fire at the zombies.
- Different items hit zombies differently (e.g. Grenade = powerful, Couch = splash damage, plushie = weak but funny).
- If all 7 slots fill without a match, that is a blunder: the tray clears and the zombies get enraged, but play carries on. A blunder is a tempo penalty, not a loss.
- Win: every zombie on screen is eliminated.
- Lose: the zombies reach us and our HP runs out.
Reference: Brian's recorded reference level (video shared in the channel on 24 Sep) and our deck "ZM3D playable - reference level" show what we built for you.

4. Board items: the 8 on the board
Grenade, Couch, Plushie Chick, Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box, Cactus Plant, Bow.
(Grenade, Couch and Plushie Chick come from the reference level. Bow replaced Dynamite in the 8. The Bow goes in as it is now; an arrow may come later as its own item.)
Every other board item on the hand-off list is an extra that you can swap in through the editable board, Dynamite included.

5. Zombies and animation
- Four zombies: Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player. All four are in the Unity package Marcus sent on 26 Sep.
- One animation: walk. Please apply it to all four when you re-rig them in Spine.
- We may add more zombies later, depending on size.

6. Sound and music
- You can use these sounds: Matching, Success and Failure (made in-house), plus the background music (a new ad track made in-house, not the in-game track).
- The Rocket and Explosion sounds currently in the game come from a library and a bought pack, so we can't hand them over. Calvin is making our own versions; they are owed on the hand-off list.
- Music: as per your rule from last time, the music may only start after the player's first click.

7. Formats (as you gave them to us; these still hold)
- 3D: .fbx (Binary, not ASCII), .glb or .blend
- 2D: .png (2D animations need character parts separated into pieces)
- Font: .ttf or .woff2
- Sound: .mp3 or .wav

8. What is still coming from us
The hand-off list sheet ("ZM3D playable - hand-off list") has one row per asset. Each row shows its state (Delivered / Ready / Owed), what is still owed and who has it. As of 1 Oct: 8 Delivered, 68 Ready, 20 Owed.
- Delivered: you have the current file and can use it.
- Ready: exported in a format you take and sitting in our outgoing folder. It opens, it's the current version and nobody is changing it.
- Owed: everything else.

input.message:
Done. The brief and hand-off list are in my Drive, shared view-only with you, Brian, Robert and PlayableX intake.
• Brief: https://docs.google.com/document/d/8505dd1432aa4998b4b74087/edit
• Hand-off list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1g2aY3O7AfSz4XXKvmAy2dXdG35_Ll5C8uT0iQoSkxds/edit

Counts across the 96 lines:
• *Delivered: 8*
• *Ready: 68*
• *Owed: 20*. Claire 9, Brian 7, Calvin 3, Martin 1.

Things that changed from Brian's notes:
• Robert put the Bow in the 8 in place of Dynamite on 26 Sep. The board is now Grenade, Couch, Plushie Chick, Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box, Cactus Plant, Bow.
• Cactus, Chainsaw and Cone got new colour versions on 29 Sep, after Claire's export, so they need to go again. The Cactus is on the board.
• Rocket and Explosion sounds are from a library and a bought pack, so they stay here until Calvin makes our own.
• Zombies: Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player, walk animation only.

The 20 Owed tickets are in Todo with a comment saying what's owed and who has it.

Hi PlayableX team! Ahead of the 3 November start, here's the brief to build from and our hand-off list:
• Brief: https://docs.google.com/document/d/8505dd1432aa4998b4b74087/edit
• Hand-off list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1g2aY3O7AfSz4XXKvmAy2dXdG35_Ll5C8uT0iQoSkxds/edit

Both are shared view-only with intake@playablex.ai.

The hand-off list has one row per asset, marked Delivered, Ready (exported and waiting to go out to you) or Owed. Owed rows say what's still coming from us. As of today, 20 items are still owed. These include a re-export of the Cactus Plant (one of the 8 board items), our own rocket and explosion sounds, the background music loop, fonts, item icons and UI PNGs.

To answer your zombie question: please use one animation, walk, on Party Girl, Plumber, Magician and Football Player. All four are in the Unity package from 26 Sep.

The brief reflects the game as it is today. If the core changes, we'll go through the affected parts with you in November.
